title: Nutty Nibbles
description: Crackers made from blitzed mixed nuts and seeds, bound with egg and water. Failsafe party nibbles that work beautifully with dips or cheese.

ingredients.text: 350g salted mixed nuts and seeds (Brazil nuts, hazelnuts, walnuts, sesame seeds, sunflower seeds)

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Line two large baking sheets with greaseproof paper.
Blitz 330g of the nuts and seeds in a blender until fine. Pour into a bowl, add the egg and water and mix into a stiff dough. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll the chilled dough between two sheets of greaseproof paper to about 0.5cm thick. Cut into long triangles and place 2cm apart on the sheets.
Wet your hands and lightly scatter water over the crackers. Finely chop the remaining 20g of nuts and sprinkle on top.
Bake for 25 minutes, swapping trays halfway through. Cool until crisp.
notes: Makes around 14 nibbles. Keeps 3–4 days in an airtight tin.
